ActionDescriptions.OnboardingPromptAction: Base action type for Buffaly onboarding prompt workflows.
ActionDescriptions.ToConnectFirstToolSkill:
to start my first Buffaly integration
Guide a new user through choosing and starting their first useful Buffaly integration, such as GitHub, Google Workspace, Tailscale, or Codex.
ActionDescriptions.ToConnectGitHubToBuffalySkill:
to set up GitHub in Buffaly
Guide a new user through connecting GitHub to Buffaly and deciding which repositories Buffaly should remember.
ActionDescriptions.ToConnectGoogleWorkspaceToBuffalySkill:
to use Google Docs and Sheets with Buffaly
Guide a new user through connecting Google Workspace concepts, documents, sheets, and account access to Buffaly.
ActionDescriptions.ToCreateCSharpSkillWalkthroughSkill:
to create native C# code for Buffaly
Guide a user through understanding how Buffaly can be extended with native compiled C# code loaded at runtime.
ActionDescriptions.ToCreateFirstBuffalyTaskSkill:
to start my first task in Buffaly
Guide a new user through turning a real goal into a bounded Buffaly task with evidence and acceptance criteria.
ActionDescriptions.ToCreatePromptSkillWalkthroughSkill:
to create my first prompt skill
Guide a user through the first level of extending Buffaly by creating reusable prompt skills with progressive examples.
ActionDescriptions.ToCreateProtoScriptSkillWalkthroughSkill:
to create my first ProtoScript action
Guide a user through creating ProtoScript actions as deterministic compiled glue code for orchestrating existing tools.
ActionDescriptions.ToExplainBuffalySelfModificationSkill:
to see how Buffaly adds tools to itself
Explain Buffaly's self-extension model in beginner-friendly language across prompts, ProtoScript, and C# code.
ActionDescriptions.ToExposeBuffalyThroughTailscaleSkill:
to make Buffaly reachable through Tailscale
Guide a new user through understanding and planning secure Buffaly access through Tailscale.
ActionDescriptions.ToSetUpCodexInsideBuffalySkill:
to connect coding help to Buffaly
Guide a new user through using Codex inside Buffaly for repository inspection, edits, validation, and commits.
ActionDescriptions.ToSetUpInitialOntologySkill:
to help Buffaly understand my work
Guide a new user through Buffaly's first setup by explaining Buffaly, collecting initial entities, prompt actions, and preferences, confirming them, and routing them through the appropriate remember workflows.
ActionDescriptions.ToShowInstallCapabilitiesSkill:
to understand the Buffaly navigation capabilities screen
Guide a new user through the Buffaly Navigation capabilities screen, explaining installed skills, tools, prompt actions, context prompts, agents, providers, services, modules, ontology, and inspection surfaces in outcome-oriented language.
ActionDescriptions.ToTeachBuffalySomethingUsefulSkill:
to remember something useful in Buffaly
Guide a new user through teaching Buffaly one useful object, preference, or repeatable workflow.
